links.outcome: Agreement of AI automated CMR ventricular measurements with manual reference on local consecutive patients
links.effect: No significant difference between automated and manual measurements (p>0.05); ICC >0.85 across all metrics; 462 studies included; failed segmentation in 1 case (0.4%).
links.quote: No statistically significant difference was demonstrated between any automated and manual measurements (p > 0.05; independent T-test).

links.outcome: Radiologist visual review of AI-generated contours for accuracy
links.effect: Contours evaluated visually in 251 cases; agreement or minor disagreement in 229 (91.2%); failed segmentation in a single case (0.4%).
links.quote: The automated contours were evaluated visually in 251 cases, with agreement or minor disagreement in 229 cases (91.2%) and failed segmentation in only a single case (0.4%).

screen.reason: Evaluates an AI cardiac MRI segmentation tool against manual expert segmentation and visual inspection on a clinical cohort, testing performance/viability rather than a specific deployment guardrail practice.
